def VTask.map {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) : Matroid β :=
  let ME : Type _ := { x : α // x ∈ M.E }
  let f' : ME → β := fun x => f x
  let hf' : Function.Injective f' :=
    by
      intro x y h
      have h_eq : f x = f y := h
      have h_inj : Set.InjOn f M.E := hf
      show x = y
      have : f x = f y := h_eq
      exact Subtype.ext (h_inj.eq this)
  Matroid.mapEmbedding M f'
